g.text: RP2354A orchestration coprocessor, drawn on two sub-sheets

g.desc: RP2354A orchestration coprocessor, drawn on two sub-sheets

g.text: 1. Function: RP2354A orchestration coprocessor (BRD-014, should); flashed by Blackbird OS over

g.desc: 1. Function: RP2354A orchestration coprocessor (BRD-014, should); flashed by Blackbird OS over

g.text: SWD or USB BOOTSEL (BRD-015); never in a data path (BRD-005); the SoC boots without it (BRD-019).

g.desc: SWD or USB BOOTSEL (BRD-015); never in a data path (BRD-005); the SoC boots without it (BRD-019).

g.text: 2. Absent state: unfitted or RP_PWR_EN low: rails off; RP_IRQ low (no wake); UART, SWD and RUN

g.desc: 2. Absent state: unfitted or RP_PWR_EN low: rails off; RP_IRQ low (no wake); UART, SWD and RUN

g.text: parked low by the SoC; the I2S taps reach FT pads only (3.63 V at IOVDD 0 V, G4).

g.desc: parked low by the SoC; the I2S taps reach FT pads only (3.63 V at IOVDD 0 V, G4).

g.text: 3. Drawn on two sub-sheets (blk.rp2354-core, blk.rp2354-power) holding the units of one part.

g.desc: 3. Drawn on two sub-sheets (blk.rp2354-core, blk.rp2354-power) holding the units of one part.
